messages:
sarah-cs: Heads up — AegisHealth pilot usage dropped sharply yesterday. Seat activity at ~28% vs baseline, embed calls down. Flagging for renewal watch.
ravi-am: Saw the spike. Any errors in logs or recent deploys? @alice-eng can you eyeball infra/routing?
alice-eng: quick look — no cluster OOMs. Noticed elevated 500s on /v1/embeds around 03:20 UTC. snippet:
```2025-03-05 03:20:17 GET /v1/embeds 500 upstream timeout```
devon-csm: Their champion Dirk is OOO; procurement lead (Marta) is now triaging. Marta mentioned cost concerns and a parallel eval with a smaller vendor.
ravi-am: Procurement already pinged us yesterday about tiering. Could be they paused calls to avoid cost. Marta — did they tell us a timeline?
sarah-cs: Reached out to Marta — she said they also saw "weird reranker ordering" and paused runs. Wants a quick QA check before resuming.
alice-eng: Can reproduce inconsistent rerank outputs on a small prompt set. Pinning model to v2.1 restores expected ordering. Initiating a routing patch to pin AegisHealth traffic to v2.1 for now. ETA ~30m.
ops-bot: Patch run-7831 started. Canary on 3 hosts.
devon-csm: I'll offer a short walkthrough for Marta and propose a QA checklist. Also asking procurement for their RFP window and whether they're evaluating alternatives.
ravi-am: Preparing a renewal note: propose 2-week service credit + priority support if they commit to continue pilot. Will wait for patch outcome first.
ops-bot: Patch completed on canary. Health checks green. Rolling to remaining hosts in 12m.
sarah-cs: Thanks — I'll update Marta and Dirk's backup. If Marta reports no improvement, escalate to swat and we'll open a quick RCA. :thumbsup:
